Perfectly Served Valentine's Day Champagne

Served at: Saint Valentine's Day

Serves 2Prep 10 min (plus chilling time)

Champagne is the quintessential beverage for celebrating love and romance, making it a perfect choice for Saint Valentine's Day. Its effervescent bubbles and crisp taste elevate any romantic occasion, symbolizing joy and luxury. Serving it correctly ensures the best experience for you and your loved one.

Ingredients

  • 1 (750 ml) bottle chilled Brut Champagne or sparkling wine
  • 2-4 fresh raspberries (optional, for garnish)
  • 2 sugar cubes (optional, for a classic Champagne cocktail)
  • 2-4 dashes Angostura bitters (optional, for a classic Champagne cocktail)

Method

  1. Ensure your Champagne bottle is thoroughly chilled to 45-50°F (7-10°C) by refrigerating it horizontally for at least 3 hours or in an ice bucket for 30 minutes.
  2. Prepare your flutes: ensure they are clean and polished. If making a classic Champagne cocktail, place one sugar cube in the bottom of each flute and add 1-2 dashes of Angostura bitters to each cube.
  3. To open the bottle, remove the foil and then carefully untwist the wire cage while keeping your thumb firmly on the cork.
  4. Holding the bottle at a 45-degree angle, firmly grip the cork with one hand and slowly twist the bottle (not the cork) with the other hand. Ease the cork out gently to release a whisper, not a loud pop.
  5. Pour the Champagne slowly into each flute, tilting the glass slightly to allow the bubbles to cascade gently and prevent excessive foam. Fill each glass about two-thirds full.
  6. If desired, drop 1-2 fresh raspberries into each flute for a touch of color and fruitiness.
  7. Serve immediately and enjoy your romantic Valentine's Day toast.

Tips

  • Always chill Champagne properly to enhance its flavor and prevent gushing upon opening.
  • For a non-alcoholic alternative, use a sparkling cider or non-alcoholic sparkling wine and garnish similarly.
  • Pair Champagne with light appetizers like oysters, cheese, or chocolate-dipped strawberries for a perfect Valentine's Day experience.
